messages:
michael.l: Quick heads-up — Pierre's dashboard sprint starts Monday and we still don't have stable metric names for errors/fallbacks. can we lock these today?
priya: +1. Need to be clear about semantics: 'degraded_mode' means runtime served a degraded path (e.g., quantized model or reduced context) vs 'fallback' means we hit an explicit fall-through to a different model/endpoint.
tomas: Totally. current infra emits only generic error counters, so console ends up showing double-counts. we should agree on labels: service, route, model_variant, outcome(reason), customer_tier.
leah: Also need to decide where to emit: gateway (api-level 5xx/timeouts), runtime (OOMs/degraded), and router (quota rejections). each source needs unique metric names or a source label.
jordan: proposal from runtime side: emit these metrics (Prometheus names):
```
redwood_runtime_errors_total{source="runtime", kind="5xx", route="/v1/generate", model_variant="r3-small"}
redwood_runtime_degraded_total{source="runtime", reason="kv_cache_eviction"}
redwood_runtime_fallbacks_total{source="runtime", from_variant="r3-small", to_variant="r2-fallback"}
redwood_gateway_timeouts_total{source="gateway", route="/v1/chat"}
redwood_quota_rejects_total{source="router", quota_policy="per-org"}
```
priya: love that. add an "outcome" label with values like ok, degraded, fallback, rejected, error. will help dashboards.
anya: can we standardize label keys: service, env, route, model_variant, outcome, reason, customer_tier? console expects those exact keys.
michael.l: yep standardization is the most important. if one team uses 'model' and another 'model_variant' dashboards break.
tomas: runtime patch ready, but we need a minimal transform in the telemetry bridge to add source= and to normalize label names. I can PR today.
leah: who owns dedupe logic? some requests spawn both gateway and runtime errors (timeout at gateway, runtime logs oom). dashboards should not double-count a single user-facing failure.
jordan: suggestion: dashboards should be event-sourced by highest-severity source per request_id. router/gateway mark request_id; runtime attaches same request_id. Then Grafana panels can do cardinality based on request_id dedupe.
priya: ok but request_id propagation needs to be pinned in the API layer. is that already guaranteed for private deployments?
anya: not always for on-prem. we should provide a fallback: use sampled dedupe via 1) request_id when available else 2) dedupe window by client_ip+route+minute. document caveats.
michael.l: for Pierre's panels we can ship a temporary 'best_effort' deduped metric produced in telemetry bridge: redwood_errors_deduped_5m_total. make it clear it's derived.
leah: alerts: we should move to SLO-driven thresholds: error ratio by route/model over 5m with severity tiers. avoid pure absolute counts.
jordan: sample PromQL for alerting: 
```
sum(rate(redwood_errors_deduped_5m_total{route="/v1/generate"}[5m]))
/
sum(rate(redwood_requests_total{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) > 0.01
```
michael.l: UX note for Console: add a filter toggle "Include degraded as errors" with explanation. product needs to decide default.
priya: product asked degraded NOT to count as hard errors by default, but to show them in a separate column and let teams enable combined error view.
anya: telemetry bridge will tag degraded with outcome="degraded" and add metric redwood_degraded_total. console can combine when user toggles.
leah: OOMs — runtime will emit redwood_runtime_oom_total with labels node, model_variant, route. please include stack-sample id to link to traces.
jordan: deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for runtime patch 22:15 UTC tonight.
deploy-bot: runtime/metrics: release/22.1 deployed to staging at 2026-03-20T22:15:00Z :white_check_mark:
michael.l: thanks everyone. plan: Tomas PR to normalize labels, Runtime to emit the new names, Telemetry bridge to produce deduped derived metric, Console team to add UI toggle and Pierre to build initial panels from deduped metric. sync at 10am tomorrow if needed. :thumbsup:
priya: I'll file the spec and the small product doc. linking in #eng-platform once done.
anya: i'll open the telemetry PR and add migration notes for private customers.
leah: i'll draft alerting playbook for oncall.
michael.l: done — thanks all.
